## HistogramChart

`histogram-chart` · Raw observations binned in the core.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `HistogramChart` | `SpHistogramChart` | `sp-histogram-chart` | `histogram_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/histogram-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/histogram-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/histogram-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `distribution`; intents `distribution`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through valueKey="minutes"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "reader": "R001", "device": "desktop", "minutes": 4 }, { "reader": "R002", "device": "phone", "minutes": 17 }, { "reader": "R003", "device": "phone", "minutes": 3 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `bins` | `number \| readonly number[]` |  | A number asks for that many equal-width bins over the niced extent; an array gives the thresholds, increasing. Freedman–Diaconis by default, Sturges when the IQR is 0 (REQ-432). |
| `cumulative` | `boolean` |  | Turns the counts into a running total. |
| `orientation` | `ChartOrientation` |  |  |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { HistogramChart } from '@silverpoint/react/histogram-chart';

export function HistogramChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <HistogramChart
      data={rows}
      valueKey="minutes"
      title="Histogram chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpHistogramChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/histogram-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpHistogramChart
    :data="rows"
    valueKey="minutes"
    title="Histogram chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
}
```

## RidgelineChart

`ridgeline-chart` · A kernel density per group on overlapping baselines.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `RidgelineChart` | `SpRidgelineChart` | `sp-ridgeline-chart` | `ridgeline_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ridgeline-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/ridgeline-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/ridgeline-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `distribution`; intents `distribution`, `compare`, `change`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |
| group | `groupKey` | string | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through valueKey="ms", groupKey="service"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "service": "Search", "ms": 220 }, { "service": "Search", "ms": 177 }, { "service": "Search", "ms": 158 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `groupKey` | `Accessor<string \| null \| undefined>` |  | **Required.** The group of an observation; one ridge per group. Ignored without `data`. |
| `bandwidth` | `number` |  | Kernel bandwidth in data units, shared by every group; Silverman's rule by default. |
| `overlap` | `number` | `0.5` | How far a ridge reaches into the one behind it, 0-1; 0.5 by default. |

## DumbbellChart

`dumbbell-chart` · Two values per category joined by a segment.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `DumbbellChart` | `SpDumbbellChart` | `sp-dumbbell-chart` | `dumbbell_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/dumbbell-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/dumbbell-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/dumbbell-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `categories`; intents `change`, `compare`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | `labelKey` | string | yes |
| start | `startKey` | number | yes |
| end | `endKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through labelKey="clinic", startKey="y2024", endKey="y2025", names=["2024","2025"]), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "clinic": "Ashford", "y2024": 59, "y2025": 66 }, { "clinic": "Brook Lane", "y2024": 24, "y2025": 30 }, { "clinic": "Castlegate", "y2024": 33, "y2025": 47 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'label'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `startKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'start'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `endKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'end'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `names` | `readonly [string, string]` | `['start', 'end']` | Titles of the two values; `['start', 'end']` by default. Ignored without `data`. |
| `endMarker` | `'dot' \| 'arrow'` |  | `arrow` encodes the direction from the first value to the second. |
| `orientation` | `ChartOrientation` | `rows` | `rows` by default: long category names read across. |

## SlopeChart

`slope-chart` · Two period axes, one segment per category.

## BumpChart

`bump-chart` · The rank of each series at each x.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `BumpChart` | `SpBumpChart` | `sp-bump-chart` | `bump_chart` |

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through xKey="season", seriesKey="team", valueKey="points"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

## DivergingBarChart

`diverging-bar-chart` · Ordered levels stacked on both sides of a neutral centre.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `DivergingBarChart` | `SpDivergingBarChart` | `sp-diverging-bar-chart` | `diverging_bar_chart` |

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | `labelKey` | string | yes |
| levels | `levels` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through labelKey="question", levels=["Strongly disagree","Disagree","Neutral","Agree","Strongly agree"]), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "question": "The site is easy to use", "Strongly disagree": 43, "Disagree": 53, "Neutral": 50, "Agree": 24, "Strongly agree": 29 }, { "question": "Prices are fair", "Strongly disagree": 38, "Disagree": 36, "Neutral": 62, "Agree": 42, "Strongly agree": 21 }, { "question": "Delivery was on time", "Strongly disagree": 40, "Disagree": 42, "Neutral": 45, "Agree": 31, "Strongly agree": 41 } ]
```

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).
